hebrewText: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַ/יָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּ/צִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר

tokens.bdb: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
tokens.kjv: appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.

tokens.bdb: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
tokens.kjv: edge, [idiom] (mighty) God (one), rock, [idiom] sharp, stone, [idiom] strength, [idiom] strong. See also H1049 (בֵּית צוּר).

tokens.bdb: to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow
tokens.kjv: flow, gush out, have a (running) issue, pine away, run.

tokens.bdb: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: (all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart, [phrase] be eased, enter, exercise (self), [phrase] follow, forth, forward, get, go (about, abroad, along, away, forward, on, out, up and down), [phrase] greater, grow, be wont to haunt, lead, march, [idiom] more and more, move (self), needs, on, pass (away), be at the point, quite, run (along), [phrase] send, speedily, spread, still, surely, [phrase] tale-bearer, [phrase] travel(-ler), walk (abroad, on, to and fro, up and down, to places), wander, wax, (way-) faring man, [idiom] be weak, whirl.

tokens.kjv: barren, drought, dry (land, place), solitary place, wilderness.

tokens.bdb: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
